dedupe_keys.name: national wastewater treatment facilities geoscience australia locations and attributes of 1 363 wastewater treatment plants

description: Geoscience Australia's National Wastewater Treatment Facilities database gives the locations of Australia's known wastewater treatment plants. The facilities were first digitised in 2011-12 from orthophotos and satellite imagery of 0.15 m to 2.5 m resolution and released in March 2015. On 2026-09-29 the web feature service reported 1,363 facilities, each with feature type and subtype, name, description, owner, operator, address, locality, state, postcode, status, feature and attribute sources and dates, spatial confidence, input product, byproduct, treated water use, and latitude and longitude. Coverage: national, Australia. Format and access: free downloads (file geodatabase, CSV, KML, XLS, a product map and a metadata PDF) through data.gov.au, and WMS and WFS services from services.ga.gov.au. Licence: CC BY 4.0 on the data.gov.au record of the 2012 release; other listings of the same data leave the licence unspecified. Caveats: Geoscience Australia's eCat record 74625 returned not found in 2026; capacity and population served are not given. Simulation uses: hazard exposure of treatment plants to flood and sea level rise, and cascading failure models linking wastewater with power and water supply. Related records: compare with the global HydroWASTE database (data-hydrowaste) and Geoscience Australia's national liquid fuel facilities (data-ga-national-liquid-fuel-facilities).
